why: Hardcodes the Customize preview's reduced-motion flag, which is what the module did before issue #320 in a different form -- it read `window.matchMedia` itself, so the OS was the only input and a player who wanted full effects anyway had no say. Killed by loop.test.ts's four-row motion sweep, which drives all three player-facing states against an OS preference set opposite to the expected answer wherever the override applies. 1 of 366. RE-ANCHORED for issue #427: the Customize preview's construction moved from `startGameWith` to `route-ui.ts` with the rest of the application-route handlers, so the find string named a file that no longer contains it -- which the harness reports as `failed-to-apply`, but only to whoever runs it. The line, the mutation and the killing test are unchanged; only `file` moved. The count below was re-measured on the new location rather than carried over.
